title: Spotify Track Popularity Prediction
description: Built a distributed ML pipeline in PySpark on the SDSC Expanse supercomputer, processing 256M+ records (189GB). Tuned a Random Forest model to RMSE 2.56 and R² 0.742 with a 4.39x speedup over a single-executor baseline.

title: PDF Invoice Extraction Pipeline
description: Built an end-to-end pipeline that turns PDF invoices from five vendors into structured JSON, using pdfplumber, per-vendor regex and table extraction, and a HuggingFace zero-shot classifier (bart-large-mnli).

title: Restaurant Cuisine Classification
description: Built a TF-IDF and scikit-learn pipeline classifying restaurants into 10 cuisines, reaching a macro-F1 of 0.76 on imbalanced data after fixing a feature-scaling bug that had dropped the score to 0.11.

title: Database Design and Automation
description: Designed normalized MySQL schemas, automated workflows with stored procedures, and built a full MySQL database solution for an app prototype integrating SQL, Python, and Tableau (Meta Database Engineering Specialization).

title: HydroBud
description: Led a cross-functional team of 5 to build an MVP hydroponic plant health monitoring system with Arduino, React, and Firestore in 3 months. Authored the PRD and ran the team on Kanban with 100% sprint completion.

title: Video Player Preview Page
description: Worked with a 10+ engineer team at Cadent to build a video preview page. Evaluated 12 video players, set up an Apache Tomcat server to host the page, and implemented click events for ad playback with pop-up video previews.

title: Serverless Backend Workflows
description: Designed and shipped 7 Python AWS Lambda functions at Opal powering core backend workflows, cutting DynamoDB/S3 sync processing time by 35%.

title: Matching Algorithm Optimization
description: Re-engineered the ANNOY matching algorithm at Opal, consolidating pipeline steps to cut runtime by 40%.

title: Account Features
description: Implemented new account features at Opal, including profile liking, goal setting, and an Admin account type with unique access codes.

title: Incomplete Profile Error Handling
description: Established error handling for incomplete user profiles at Opal, preventing system crashes.

title: Expungement Eligibility Parser
description: Developed a Python parser for the Paper Prisons project at the SCU Frugal Innovation Hub, analyzing over 1 million records to determine expungement eligibility with 95% accuracy.

title: Clean Slate Audits and Research Visualizations
description: Generated clean slate audits, statistical reports, and data visualizations for published research contributing to the academic paper "America's Paper Prisons: The Second Chance Gap."
